distributed_workflow_discrepancy.notes: Planned study specification intended six independent reviewer packages of 20 clips each (reviewer_01_package.zip to reviewer_06_package.zip under distributed_batches/). However, actual responses exist solely as reviewer_01_responses.csv containing all 120 clips evaluated in a single session using the centralized template format. No response files exist for reviewers 02-06. Therefore, the provenance of multi-reviewer distributed execution is marked UNRESOLVED (not executed in field). The single-reviewer provenance is verified for the 120-clip centralized evaluation.
